_meta.what: Thai effect text for the memorial gear pieces the Thai client has no text for yet (ranks II Contingent and I Conqueror, not released on Global). Translated by hand on 1 Oct 2026 from the English item text in our items table, using the Thai client's own wording for the same stats on ranks IV and III (ลดระยะเวลาร่ายแบบแปรผัน, เมื่ออัปเกรดถึงขั้น ...). Set partners are named as this site names the pieces. Superseded per piece once the Thai client ships its own text (lib/memorial-gear thaiEffect wins).
